summary: Master the art of feedback with our Effective Feedback and Performance Conversations Course. Boost communication skills and drive team success effectively.
lede: Training in performance feedback helps managers, team leaders, and HR professionals prepare and follow through on evidence-based conversations. It covers using SBI to describe behavior, applying GROW to coach development, and connecting feedback to goals while handling difficult discussions. Participants also practice building improvement plans, recording action points, and tracking progress through documented follow-up.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who need to handle performance conversations, appraisal discussions, and coaching moments with greater consistency and confidence.
prerequisites: No formal prerequisites are required. The course is suitable if you already supervise people, support managers, or contribute to performance processes and want a more structured approach to feedback, coaching, and appraisal conversations. For the best learning experience, bring a current or recent performance conversation challenge, a sample appraisal form, or a goal-setting template from your workplace so you can apply the exercises directly to your own context.
